parameters.query: =WITH job AS (SELECT id, requested_outputs FROM content_jobs WHERE id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid), gate AS (SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_approvals WHERE job_id=(SELECT id FROM job) AND approval_stage='plan' AND decision='approved') AS allowed), outputs AS (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE((SELECT requested_outputs FROM job),'[]'::jsonb)) AS output_type), inserted AS (INSERT INTO content_tasks (job_id,task_type,task_key,status,input_payload) SELECT (SELECT id FROM job),'generation',output_type,'queued',jsonb_build_object('source','route_output_tasks','output_type',output_type) FROM outputs, gate WHERE allowed ON CONFLICT (job_id,task_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING id), event_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata) SELECT (SELECT id FROM job),'output_tasks_routed','Output generation tasks routed',jsonb_build_object('created_tasks',(SELECT count(*) FROM inserted),'allowed',(SELECT allowed FROM gate))) SELECT (SELECT allowed FROM gate) AS allowed, (SELECT count(*) FROM inserted) AS created_tasks;
